en.headline:
Familiar words.
Unexpected meanings.
en.intro: A collection of poetic reinterpretations, made for reading, wandering and sharing one blue card at a time.
en.concept_title: A word game, not a reference book.
en.concept: Blue Dictionary gives everyday Chinese words a personal, playful second meaning. “Good night” becomes a save point in a daily conversation. Each card keeps its English wording, paraphrase and credited source together.
en.concept_note: These are the collection’s creative interpretations, not standard definitions, verified quotations or language-learning translations.
en.shelf_note: A small reading sample using the app’s actual bundled entries and card fields. The full app offers search and browsing; this sample saves nothing.
en.features_title: Look for a word. Or let one find you.
features: Type Chinese, English or a credited source. The app uses fuzzy matching over these fields, so a query can return a close match rather than an exact spelling. Select a result to open its card.
Move to the previous or next entry with the arrow keys, or use Space for another random card while a card is open. On touch screens you can swipe between entries.
Heart a word to store a favorite in this browser. Export a card as a PNG, or share a link that opens the same word. There is no account or cloud sync.
Tap the circular photo on the home screen to play or pause a looping lo-fi track. This is background music, not pronunciation audio.
steps: Enter a word such as 晚安, its English label, or a source name. With an empty search, the search button opens the suggested random word.
The Chinese word, English label, creative interpretation, English paraphrase and source credit are separate fields. Read them together.
Use arrows to continue, H to favorite, E to export or S to share. Esc closes the card. Share uses your browser’s share sheet when supported, otherwise a copied link.
en.gallery_note: Current live interface, captured while searching and browsing the bundled collection.
gallery: A quiet home screen with a record, search and keyboard hints.
Searching 晚安 finds the bundled Good night entry.
The opened card keeps its interpretation and source together.
Right Arrow moves to the next bundled entry, 礼物.
en.runtime: Open the hosted app without signing in or adding an API key. The words are bundled with the project; search does not call an AI model. Favorites stay in localStorage on the current browser and site origin.
en.limits: Sharing and image export depend on browser support. Clearing site data removes local favorites. Music starts only when you choose to play it; it is not speech or a pronunciation guide.
en.local_note: Install dependencies, start the Next.js development server, then open the local address it prints.
en.credit_note: Entries retain the 出处 field supplied by the project. The app acknowledges 上山养大猫 and credits background music to Purrple Cat. A displayed attribution is the collection’s attribution, not independent verification of a quotation.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline:
熟悉的词。
另一种解释。
zh.intro: 一份关于日常词语的诗意重释集。读一张蓝色卡片，漫游、停留，再分享给别人。
zh.concept_title: 文字游戏，不是工具辞典。
zh.concept: 蓝色词典为日常中文词语提供私人而有趣的第二种解释。“晚安”可以是每天聊天的存档点。每张卡片把英文词名、重释、英文转述与出处放在一起。
zh.concept_note: 这些是词集里的创作性解读，并非标准释义、已核实的名人语录或语言学习译文。
zh.shelf_note: 这个阅读样例直接使用应用内置词条与卡片字段。完整应用提供搜索和连续浏览；此处不会保存数据。
zh.features_title: 找一个词，也让词找到你。
features: 输入中文、英文或出处名。应用对这三个字段进行模糊匹配，因此可能返回接近的词，而非只匹配完整拼写。选择结果即可打开卡片。
卡片打开时用方向键前后浏览，按空格随机换词。触屏上也可以左右滑动，继续读相邻词条。
用爱心把喜欢的词保存在当前浏览器。也可以导出 PNG，或分享能直接打开同一词条的链接。无需账号，也没有云端同步。
点击首页圆形照片可播放或暂停循环的 lo-fi 音乐。这是背景音乐，并不是单词发音。
steps: 输入“晚安”、英文词名，或出处名。搜索框为空时，点击搜索按钮会打开当前随机推荐词。
中文词名、英文词名、创作重释、英文转述与出处是不同字段，适合放在一起理解。
方向键继续，H 收藏，E 导出，S 分享，Esc 关闭卡片。支持时会打开浏览器分享面板，否则复制词条链接。
zh.gallery_note: 从当前线上应用采集，展示内置词集的搜索与连续浏览。
gallery: 首页的唱片、搜索与键盘提示。
搜索“晚安”，找到内置的 Good night 词条。
打开卡片，重释与出处一起保留。
按向右方向键，切换到下一个内置词条“礼物”。
zh.runtime: 打开线上应用即可使用，无需登录或 API key。词条随项目内置，搜索不会调用 AI 模型。收藏存储于当前浏览器和网站域名的 localStorage 中。
zh.limits: 分享与图片导出受浏览器支持情况影响。清除网站数据会移除本地收藏。音乐只在主动播放后开始，它不是语音或发音指南。
zh.local_note: 安装依赖，启动 Next.js 开发服务器，再打开终端输出的本地地址。
zh.credit_note: 每条词保留项目提供的“出处”字段。应用致谢“上山养大猫”，背景音乐署名 Purrple Cat。页面展示的是词集的署名，并不代表已经独立核实某句引文的来源。
zh.footer: Songhai Fan 的 Frankie 系列项目
